root object
├─ kind string
├─ billingAddress object
├─ when property "billingAddress" exists <type unspecified>
│  └─ billingCountry string [required]
├─ when property "recursive" exists -> root [recursive]
├─ if <type unspecified>
│  └─ kind = "digital" [required]
├─ then <type unspecified>
│  └─ downloadUrl string [required] [format: uri]
└─ else <type unspecified>
   └─ shippingAddress -> Address [required]

Definitions
└─ Address object
   └─ postalCode string [required]
